## Same movement, different starting point {#iv2-recap .component-lesson .vector-lesson}

What changes when we translate the arrow? What stays the same?

<div data-vector="equal" class="v-interactive"></div>

<div class="c-retrieval"><span>Add head to tail.</span><span>A negative reverses direction.</span><span>A scalar changes the size and may reverse direction.</span></div>

::: notes
Use the familiar draggable equal-vector activity with button alternatives. Translate the orange vector and elicit equal magnitude and direction. Ask students to describe the movement in grid units: three right, two up. Retrieve the three geometric rules before introducing numerical components. The tail is free to move; formal head-minus-tail calculation is deferred to Lesson 3.
:::
